title: Conectores de contraste: although, despite, however, whereas

rule.title: Linkers of contrast
rule.explanation:
Para contraponer ideas:
- «although» / «even though» + sujeto + verbo («even though» es más enfático): «Although I like the colours, it feels too simple.»
- «despite» / «in spite of» + nombre o «-ing»: «In spite of being simple, it's faster.», «Despite the rain, we went out.»
- «despite the fact that» + frase: «Despite the fact that it was raining, we went out.»
- «however» / «nevertheless» empiezan una frase nueva y van seguidos de coma («nevertheless» es más formal): «However, our research shows…»
- «whereas» / «while» contrastan dos hechos en la misma frase: «Your site takes ten seconds, whereas this one takes two.»

Ojo con los errores típicos:
- «despite» nunca lleva «of» («despite of» está mal), pero «in spite of» sí.
- «although» y «but» no van juntos («Although it was late, but…» está mal).
- «despite» no va con una frase directamente («despite it was raining» está mal): «despite the rain» o «despite the fact that it was raining».

rows: Although it was late, we stayed.
Despite the fact that it rained, …
I like tea, whereas he likes coffee.

while

items.question: A pesar de la lluvia, salimos.
options: Despite the rain, we went out.
Despite of the rain, we went out.

items.question: Aunque era tarde, nos quedamos.
options: Although it was late, we stayed.
Although it was late, but we stayed.

items.question: A pesar de que llovía…
options: Despite the fact that it was raining…
Despite it was raining…

items.question: Sin embargo, funcionó.
options: However, it worked.
Although, it worked.

items.question: Yo prefiero el té, mientras que él prefiere el café.
options: I prefer tea, whereas he prefers coffee.
I prefer tea, despite he prefers coffee.

items.question: A pesar de estar cansada, terminó.
options: Despite being tired, she finished.
Despite she was tired, she finished.

items.question: Aun así, deberíamos intentarlo.
options: Nevertheless, we should try.
Despite, we should try.

items.question: Aunque me gusta, es caro.
options: Even though I like it, it's expensive.
Even I like it, it's expensive.

items.question: A pesar de eso…
options: In spite of that…
In spite that…

items.question: Tu web tarda diez segundos, mientras que esta tarda dos.
options: Your site takes ten seconds, whereas this one takes two.
Your site takes ten seconds, however this one takes two.

sets.instructions: Une las frases con el conector indicado.
